title: Third-order affine replacement bound
statement:
Let $([?]$) be probability spaces $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$, and let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and $Y\colon\Xi\to\mathbb R$ have finite third absolute moments. Suppose their means and second moments agree. Let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be three times continuously differentiable, and suppose $|\psi^{(3)}(t)|\le C$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$. Then, for all $a,b\in\mathbb R$,
\[
\left|\int \psi(a+bX)\,d\mu-\int \psi(a+bY)\,d\nu\right|
\le \frac C6 |b|^3\left(\int |X|^3\,d\mu+\int |Y|^3\,d\nu\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: $X$ and $Y$ have finite third absolute moments
